verdict.rationale: Docs describe LlamaParse as 'layout-aware' and producing 'clean markdown' from complex layouts, tables, and charts, and one HN commenter found it impressive on documents with complex layout — implying headings/sections/reading order are preserved in markdown output. However, another hands-on report notes tables aren't returned in clean tabular form (only via QA), and no documentation explicitly discusses heading-level hierarchy or reading-order fidelity as a named feature. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of heading/section hierarchy preservation, independent benchmarking of reading-order accuracy, and resolution of the table-structure complaint.
